articles.headline: Creative agencies gear up for high-decibel festive ad campaigns across India
articles.summary: Major creative networks and independent shops report a surge in multi-channel brand pitches ahead of the Q3 festive season, with quick-commerce and consumer durables leading ad spend growth.

articles.headline: FMCG giants pivot towards regional language digital storyboards in rural push
articles.summary: Consumer brands are reallocating up to 40% of their digital video production budgets into vernacular dialects to capture Tier-3 and rural markets.

articles.headline: AI-driven programmatic ad buying sees double-digit adoption among Indian brands
articles.summary: Automated audience segmentation and real-time creative optimization tools are transforming agency workflows across Mumbai and Bengaluru.

articles.headline: OTT streaming platforms introduce interactive shoppable ad formats for live sports
articles.summary: Viewers can now purchase products directly through on-screen QR prompts and connected TV apps during major tournament broadcasts.

articles.headline: Industry veteran appointed as Chief Creative Officer at Dentsu Creative India
articles.summary: The leadership change aims to bolster the agency's creative output across integrated digital, experiential, and brand strategy verticals.

articles.headline: Automotive sector ramps up connected TV spends targeting young urban buyers
articles.summary: Electric vehicle manufacturers and SUV makers are doubling down on programmatic CTV inventory to reach premium household audiences.

articles.headline: Quick commerce platforms emerge as prime retail media channel for consumer tech
articles.summary: Sponsored search listings and banner placements on 10-minute delivery apps now command higher CPMs than traditional e-commerce marketplaces.

articles.headline: Creator economy in India expected to surpass $3.5 billion benchmark by 2028
articles.summary: Micro and nano influencers in tier-2 cities represent the fastest-growing cohort for FMCG and lifestyle brand sponsorships.

articles.headline: Print media ad revenue shows resilience in regional markets during state elections
articles.summary: Language dailies in Maharashtra, Haryana, and Jharkhand report strong commercial inserts from infrastructure, banking, and government sectors.

articles.headline: Global Agency of the Year shortlists announced: Record entries from Indian firms
articles.summary: Thirteen agencies headquartered in Mumbai and Delhi secure finalist positions across film craft, digital innovation, and purpose-led marketing.
